@graph.name: Entry 47: which deficit form? — pre-registration of the two selections, in I/T/O/S
@graph.text: Two selections on D1 ∪ D2 (48 rides at s̄ ≥ 3%), by BIC under a Laplace likelihood, under frozen priors and again under per-ride inverted physics: BOTH return the incumbent ε₀ = 0.13, with zero fitted parameters. The same contest on D3–D6 selects the grade-inverse form decisively (ΔBIC 128.8), so the disagreement is statistical power, not direction — 48 calibration rides cannot resolve what 990 evaluation rides can, and only the calibration arm is licensed to build the tables. Nothing published moved.
